Сигнал тревоги контроля целостности

An alarm signaling a failure or inconsistency detected in the position integrity monitoring system, requiring immediate action.

Definition

An alarm signaling a failure or inconsistency detected in the position integrity monitoring system, requiring immediate action.

Operational example

Integrity monitoring alarm activated; bridge to investigate cause, switch to manual position fixing, and inform VTS if not resolved within five minutes.
